spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence uses present continuous for a temporary situation?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] I am sharing an office this month because of the building work.
B. [WRONG] I share an office with two colleagues. We have done so for years.
C. [WRONG] I shared an office when I first joined the company.
D. [WRONG] I share my workspace with the design team on Fridays.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: I share an office with two colleagues. We have done so for years., I shared an office when I first joined the company., I share my workspace with the design team on Fridays.
